status: Fixed before this reporting script reads outcome counts; retrospective analysis of an already examined experiment, not preregistration
analysis_scope: Existing 204-AI/204-COCO local watermark measurements only; no new decoding, threshold selection, model fitting, or image generation
control_queries: For each unmarked real photograph and unmarked AI source, query each fixed payload and also accept if any of the three fixed payloads matches. Queries reuse stored bits/decoded messages.
classical_rule: At least 13 of 16 decoded bits agree with the queried payload
learned_rule: Saved ECC valid, decoded schema 1 (BCH5), and full saved decoded message equals queried 16 bits plus 45 zeros
per_condition_intervals: Two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson source intervals, one transformed cover per distinct source and query
overall_average: Equal-weight mean over the 13 frozen conditions for each source, then average over sources; 2,000 source bootstrap draws using seed 20261010. These 13 repeated transforms are not independent images.
overall_any_condition: Descriptive proportion of sources accepted at least once among the 13 conditions with exact source interval; distinct from the pooled condition rate
cross_mark_queries: Matching payload of an image marked by the other watermark; report as cross-method acceptance, not photographic false positives
operating_point_constraint: All 204-source inputs are test sources. No independent learned-watermark validation scores exist here, and exact ECC/message verification has no stored equivalent soft calibration score. Do not select matched-FPR thresholds from these test outcomes or claim an equal-FPR robustness comparison.
scope_limits: COCO controls only; each selected source has one unmarked cover; shared attacks may create dependent outcomes. The public unkeyed payload and public learned embedding algorithm do not authenticate authorship. Large regeneration results have no 204-source real/unmarked controls and are excluded from these false-positive summaries.
